9992a21a33a3a98d927a.headline: Kungiyoyin matan Zinder sun tara gudummawa don asusun Nijar
9992a21a33a3a98d927a.dek: Yankin na goyon bayan kiran shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani na kowane mutum ya bada CFA100 ga Asusun Kare Ƙasa.
9992a21a33a3a98d927a.why: Ana neman kungiyoyin mata su tara gudummawar CFA100 ga kowane mutum don asusun, ba tare da bayyana jimillar kudin da aka tara ba a Zinder.
paragraphs: Kungiyoyin mata a Zinder ta Jamhuriyar Nijar sun hada albarkatu domin tallafawa Asusun Kare Ƙasa a wani taro da aka gudanar a ranar Juma'a, 20 ga Nuwamba, wanda jakadun Mata Massu Doubara suka shirya. Kamfen din na zuwa ne biyo bayan kiran da Shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani ya yi na kowane mutum ya bayar da gudummawar CFA100.

Aïssa Amadou Moudiéli, wacce ta wakilci gwamnan yankin Zinder, ta yaba da kamfen din sannan ta ce ya zo ne daidai da kiran shugaban kasa. Hadjia Mariama Maman, shugabar jakadun, ta bukaci kungiyoyin mata da su bada gudummawa. Ta ce hakan zai taimaka wajen samar da tsaro da kuma wadatar abinci, duk da cewa ba a bayyana adadin kudin da aka tara ba.

An kaddamar da shirin ne a Cibiyar Al'adun Abdoussalam Adam, inda jami'an gwamnati da na gargajiya, da shugabannin addini, da wakilan kungiyoyin mata suka halarta. Maman ta godewa abokan hulkar ci gaba da kungiyoyi masu zaman kansu da suka halarci taron, ciki har da kungiyar CARE, da aka fi sani da Cooperative for Assistance and Relief Everywhere, da kuma AFB, wata kungiya da aka ambata a rahoton.

c95b25f997435366c4d8.headline: Gwamnan Kano ya bayyana yadda aka fitar da matarsa daga Gidan Gwamnati kafin shigar da ƙarar saki
c95b25f997435366c4d8.dek: Abba Kabir Yusuf ya bayyana yadda matarsa ta bar gidan gwamnati a Kano sannan daga baya ta shigar da ƙarar saki a Abuja.
c95b25f997435366c4d8.why: Gwamna Abba Kabir Yusuf dole ne ya amsa tambayoyi a fili kan yadda matarsa ta bar Gidan Gwamnati tare da shigar da ƙarar saki a Abuja, yayin da ba a bayar da rahoton wani sabon mataki ba tukuna.
paragraphs: Jaridar Premium Times ta ruwaito cewa Gwamnan Jihar Kano Abba Kabir Yusuf ya yi bayanin yadda aka fitar da matarsa daga Gidan Gwamnati da ke Kano, wacce daga baya ta shigar da ƙarar saki a Abuja.

Jaridar The Punch ta ruwaito lamarin a ƙarƙashin kan labarin "Rigimar saki" tare da ɗauke da bayanin gwamnan, da kuma hoton da Gwammatin Jihar Kano ta samar. Rahoton bai bayyana ranar da ta bar gidan ko ranar da aka shigar da ƙarar ba, kuma bai ce wane ne ya fitar da ita ba.
Rahoton bai ba da wani ƙarin bayani game da ƙarar ko martani daga matar gwamnan ba.

c6b7f3f09cbeb4f664d8.headline: Ƙungiyar kare haƙƙi ta maka hukumar tattara bayanai da ta zaɓe ta Najeriya a kotu kan hotunan zaɓe
c6b7f3f09cbeb4f664d8.dek: Ƙungiyar SERAP na neman umarnin kotu domin tilasta gudanar da bincike kan zargin amfani da hotunan da aka kirkira da fasahar AI a cikin rajistar masu zaɓe.
c6b7f3f09cbeb4f664d8.why: Hukumar NDPC dole ne ta yanke shawara ko za ta binciki bayanan INEC 268 da aka sanya wa alama, kuma kotun na iya tilasta mata ta binciki bayanan INEC.
paragraphs: Ƙungiyar kare haƙƙin bil'adama ta Socio-Economic Rights and Accountability Project (SERAP) ta maka Hukumar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya (NDPC) da Hukumar Zaɓe Mai Zama Kanta ta Ƙasa (INEC) a Babban Kotun Tarayya da ke Abuja. Ƙarar mai lamba FHC/ABJ/CS/2863/2026, tana neman kotun ta tilasta wa NDPC ta yanke shawara kan ko za ta binciki zargin hotunan da aka kirkira ta fasahar zamani ta AI, da sauya bayanan sirri da kuma bayanan da ba za a iya tabbatar da su ba a cikin kundin rajistar masu zaɓe na wucin gadi na INEC.

INEC ta bayyana a ranar 1 ga Nuwamba cewa tsarinta na tantance halittu ta na'ura (Automated Biometric Identification System) ya sanya wa bayanan masu zaɓe 268 alama don sake dubawa, inda ake zargin wasu mutane sun yi amfani da lambobin rajista na hukuma ba da da'a ba. SERAP na son NDPC ta samu tare da bincika bayanan INEC, kuma ta yi amfani da ikon ta na sanya doka a ƙarƙashin Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya ta 2023, ciki har da bayar da umarnin gyara, tara da diyya ga masu zaɓe da abin ya shafa.
SERAP tana jayayya cewa waɗannan matsugunan sun haifar da babbar damuwa game da tsaron bayanan sirri na 'yan Najeriya da kuma amincin rajistar gabanin zaɓen gama gari na 2027.

0078e7ef3838cb2c4986.headline: CAF ta koma samun riba da sauran kuɗi dala miliyan 31.2
0078e7ef3838cb2c4986.dek: Hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Afirka ta samu ribar dala miliyan 31.2 daga cikin kudaden shiga na dala miliyan 284, wanda shi ne karo na farko da ta samu riba bayan shekaru da yawa na ƙarancin kuɗi.
0078e7ef3838cb2c4986.why: Ƙungiyoyin ƙwallon ƙafa na ƙasashe da masu tallafawa yanzu sun ga hukumar ta dawo kan samun riba, sauyin da zai shafi yadda CAF ke kashe kuɗadenta.
paragraphs: Hukumar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Afirka (CAF) ta fitar da rahoton ribar dala miliyan 31.2 na shekarar kasafin kuɗi da ta ƙare a watan Yuni na 2026, daga cikin kuɗin shiga na dala miliyan 284. An gabatar da sakamakon ne a babban taron yau da kullum na 48 na hukumar CAF da aka gudanar a Abuja a ranar 21 ga Nuwamba.

Ƙididdigar ta nuna komawa ga samun riba ga wata hukumar da ta shafe shekaru tana fuskantar matsalar kuɗi, kuma babban taron shi ne wuri da aka gabatar da hakan. Shugabancin CAF ya danganta hakan da sauye-sauyen da aka yi a ƙarƙashin jagorancin shugabanta Patrice Motsepe.
Adadin da aka bayar bai haɗa da bayanin inda kudaden shigar suka fito ko yadda za a yi amfani da ribar da aka samu ba.

717cf421f51e7dc520c0.headline: Sojojin Kogi sun kwace bindigojin AK-47 guda biyu a wani samame da suka kai maɓoyar ƴan bindiga
717cf421f51e7dc520c0.dek: Rundunar sojin ta ce an gudanar da aikin leƙen asiri a yankin Okehi ne don magance ƴan garkuwa da mutane da ke da hannu a sace-sacen baya-bayan nan a kan Hanyar Kabba da Okene.
717cf421f51e7dc520c0.why: Matafiya da mazauna ƙauyuka a kan Hanyar Kabba zuwa Okene na ci gaba da fuskantar barazanar sace su har sai an share maɓoyar da ƴan bindigar ke amfani da ita.
paragraphs: Sojojin Najeriya sun kori masu zargin da ake zargin ƴan bindiga ne daga wata maɓoya a Karamar Hukumar Okehi ta Jihar Kogi, inda suka kwace bindigojin AK-47 guda biyu, da mujallu uku da harsasai 65. An gudanar da aikin ne a ranar Asabar, 21 ga Nuwamba, 2026.

Babban Daraktan Yaɗa Labarai na Soji Kanar Appolonia Anele ya bayyana cewa sansanin sintiri na Kabba ya ƙaddamar da samamen tare da sauran jami'an tsaro. A yankunan dazuzzukan Osara, Gada da Ohakiti, sojojin sun ci karo da mutane masu ɗauke da makamai kusan shida a wani wuri da aka watsar sannan suka tilasta musu tserewa, inji sojojin. An kuma gano jakunkuna, fitilun hannu, abinci da na'urar cajin wuta da ake zargin na masu tseren ne.

Sojojin sun ce samamen ya na da nufin raba maɓoyar da ke da alaƙa da garkuwa da mutane na baya-bayan nan a kan Hanyar Kabba zuwa Okene da al'ummomin da ke kusa. Ta yi kira ga jama'a da su ci gaba da ba da bayanan da suka dace kuma abin dogaro ga hukumomin tsaro kan lokaci.

052d0a9816eed94a3a1f.headline: Najeriya da Sin sun ƙarfafa alaƙar al'adu ta hanyar waƙa
052d0a9816eed94a3a1f.dek: Jaridar The Punch ta ruwaito ƙoƙarin al'adu ta fuskar waƙa tsakanin ƙasashen biyu, amma ba ta ba da cikakken bayani kan waɗanda suka halarci taron ko shirye-shirye ba.
052d0a9816eed94a3a1f.why: Masu halartar taron daga Najeriya da Sin dole ne su aiwatar da ƙoƙarin al'adu da aka ruwaito ta hanyar waƙa, amma rahoton bai sanya wa'adin lokaci ko wani ƙarin mataki ba.
paragraphs: Najeriya da Sin na ƙarfafa alaƙar al'adu ta hanyar waƙa, inji rahoton jaridar The Punch da ta wallafa a ranar Lahadi. Rahoton ya bayyana waƙa a matsayin hanyar ƙoƙarin al'adu amma bai bayyana cikakken bayani kan wani wasa, yarjejeniya ko shiri ba.

Rahoton bai ambaci sunayen mahalarta daga Najeriya ko Sin ba, bai kuma ce inda aikin ya gudana ba, ko kuma bayyana abin da kowace ɓangare ta yi. Haka kuma bai bayar da adadin mutanen da suka halarci taron, kuɗaɗen da aka kashe ko mutanen da abin ya shafa ba.

Babu kwanan wata, ƙarin shirye-shirye ko bayanan hukuma da aka haɗa a cikin rahoton. Saboda haka bayanin da ake da shi ya tsara manufofin al'adu na ƙasashen biyu ta hanyar waƙa ba tare da bayyana yadda aikin zai ci gaba ba.

d8db490a32ef579c4ef0.headline: ProDAF ta raba kayan aikin gona ga manoma sama da 350 a yankin Diffa
d8db490a32ef579c4ef0.dek: Kunshin ya ƙunshi tan 10 na takin zamani, lita 80 na maganin kashe ƙwari da kuma iri na shinkafa, alkama, masara da kayan lambu.
d8db490a32ef579c4ef0.why: Manoma sama da 350 da suka karɓi kayan aikin za su sami iri, takin zamani da maganin kashe ƙwari a cikin wani kunshin da darajarsa ta kai CFA miliyan 15.
paragraphs: Aikin Ci gaban Noma na Iyali (ProDAF) yana ba da kayan aikin gona ga manoma sama da 350 a sassan Diffa, Mainé-Soroa da Goudoumaria, a yankin Diffa na Nijar. An tsara kunshin ne don tallafawa gonakin da ke amfani da wuraren ban ruwa da aka gina kuma aka gyara.

Ya ƙunshi tan 5 na irin shinkafa, tan 4 na irin alkama da masara kowannensu, da kilo 7 na irin kayan lambu na kabeji, albasa, tumatir, barkono da kankana. Manoman sun kuma karɓi tan 10 na takin zamani da lita 80 na maganin kashe ƙwari. Jami'an aikin sun kiyasta jimillar kuɗin da CFA miliyan 15.

Ana raba kayan aikin a duk wuraren da ke cikin sassan uku, ciki har da Chétimari, Bitoamaram da Gaouri. ProDAF ta ce goyon bayan yana da nufin ƙarfafa hanyoyin samar da kayan amfanin manoma da kuma yin amfani da zuba jari mafi kyau a fannin kayan ban ruwa.

56df9cf88455234e1f6a.headline: Gwamnan Maradi ya halarci addu'ar zaman lafiya a Nijar
56df9cf88455234e1f6a.dek: Taron da aka yi a Masallacin Taawaki ya hada da addu'a ga shugaban kasa da hukumomin kasar, tare da tunawa da marigayi El Hadj Hassan Tiani.
56df9cf88455234e1f6a.why: Gwamnan Maradi da mai bai wa shugaban kasa shawara sun halarci addu'ar jama'a domin zaman lafiya da kwanciyar hankali a Nijar a ranar 20 ga Nuwamba.
paragraphs: Gwamnan yankin Maradi, Sifeton ‘Yan Sanda Issoufou Mamane, ya halarci addu'ar gamayya domin neman zaman lafiya da kwanciyar hankali a Nijar a Masallacin Taawaki da ke Maradi a ranar Juma'a, 20 ga Nuwamba. An yi addu'ar Al Qunut ne biyo bayan sallar Juma'a.

Mai bai wa shugaban kasa shawara na musamman, Amadou Labo Maraya, ya ce taron ya hada da addu'o'i ga shugaban kasa da shugabannin kasar. Ya ce an kuma kebe shi ne domin tunawa da marigayi El Hadj Hassan Tiani, wanda aka bayyana a matsayin mahaifinsu, wanda ya rasu kimanin makonni biyu da suka gabata.
Maraya ya yi addu'ar Allah ya kai Tiani Aljanna tare the yaba da gudunmawarsa wajen bayyana wani mutum da ya kira mai hangen nesa, wanda ke aiki don jin dadin dukkan ‘yan Nijar.
